visualizerParams.title: Bug Squasher: One Exception Type Is Not Handled
visualizerParams.problemDescription: Index 5 should print Caught ArrayIndexOutOfBoundsException, but the program crashes there.

solution.explanation: Each exception type that can occur needs a matching catch. The array access at index 5 throws ArrayIndexOutOfBoundsException, which a catch for ArithmeticException alone does not cover.
